fields.description: AI service that processes the texts. OpenAI-compatible covers most other platforms, such as Mistral, Google Gemini, OpenRouter, Groq, DeepSeek, LM Studio or vLLM.
fields.label: Provider

fields.description: Address of the chat completions API without /chat/completions, e.g. http://localhost:11434/v1 for Ollama. Leave empty for the provider's default.
fields.label: Base URL
API Key
fields.description: Not needed for Ollama and many local servers.
Model name of the provider, e.g. claude-haiku-5-5 for Anthropic or llama3.2 for Ollama.
fields.label: Model

fields.description: How much the model reasons before answering. Low is fastest and cheapest. Leave empty for models without effort support.
fields.label: Effort

fields.description: Instructions sent to the model with every request. Leave empty to restore the default.
fields.label: System Prompt

fields.description: Fixed terms. Protected terms are never changed or translated; for the others, AI Writer uses the spelling and translations given here whenever a term occurs in the text.
fields.label: Glossary

fields.description: Short rules for all texts, e.g. "Address customers formally. No exclamation marks."
fields.label: House Style

fields.description: Shows the result with the changes highlighted before it replaces the text, with Apply, Regenerate and Discard.
fields.label: Preview Before Replacing

fields.description: Texts with at least this many characters are shown in the preview first.
fields.label: Minimum Length for Preview

fields.description: Instructions for writing out notes. Leave empty to restore the default.
fields.label: Write-out Prompt

fields.description: The written-out text should have at least about this many times the words of the notes.
fields.label: Minimum Expansion Factor

fields.description: The written-out text should have at most about this many times the words of the notes.
fields.label: Maximum Expansion Factor

fields.description: Instructions for drafting replies in the email composer. Leave empty to restore the default.
fields.label: Reply Prompt

fields.description: Fieldname of the Quotation text field that holds the cover letter shown in the PDF, e.g. a custom field such as custom_letter_quotation. Needs ERPNext. Leave empty to hide the button.
fields.label: Cover Letter Field

fields.description: Default format of new cover letters; it can be switched in the preview. Letter: salutation and paragraphs. Structured: title as subject and short sections for starting point, services and benefits.
fields.label: Cover Letter Format

fields.description: Shared rules for both formats. Leave empty to restore the default. Prices and totals are never sent.
fields.label: Cover Letter Prompt

fields.description: Forms of these document types offer Actions → Summarize Conversation. Leave empty to hide it.
fields.label: Document Types

fields.description: Upper limit for the length of a summary (50 to 500).
fields.label: Maximum Words

fields.description: Instructions for summaries of emails and comments. Leave empty to restore the default.
fields.label: Summary Prompt

fields.description: Target languages offered by the translate button. Leave empty to hide the button.
fields.label: Translation Languages

fields.description: Records token usage per user, not only in total. Before enabling it, check the law that applies in your country, for example on data protection and on co-determination by employee representatives.
fields.label: Track Usage per User

fields.description: Used to estimate costs. The default is the price of claude-haiku-5-5.
fields.label: Input Price per Million Tokens (USD)

fields.description: Used to estimate costs. The default is the price of claude-haiku-5-5.
fields.label: Output Price per Million Tokens (USD)

fields.description: Estimated costs per calendar month, based on the prices above. 0 means no budget.
fields.label: Monthly Budget (USD)

fields.description: When this share of the budget is used, AI Writer managers (or System Managers if there are none) get a notification and an email, once per month. 0 turns the warning off.
fields.label: Warning Threshold

fields.description: Refuse requests when the budget is used up, until the next month or until the budget is raised.
fields.label: Block When Exceeded

fields.description: Requests of a user are refused once their estimated costs this month reach this amount. 0 means no limit.
fields.label: Monthly Limit per User (USD)
